# Code of Conduct

We want cc-lb to be a respectful, useful project for operators, plugin authors, and contributors.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, specific, and constructive.
- Assume good intent while discussing technical trade-offs.
- Make room for different experience levels and working environments.
- Keep reports and discussions focused on the project and its users.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, doxxing, unwanted contact, sexualized conduct, and deliberate disruption are not acceptable. Do not post credentials, private data, or security-sensitive details in public discussions.

## Enforcement

For a conduct concern that cannot be handled safely in the public issue tracker, use the contact details on the website linked from the [repository owner's public GitHub profile](https://github.com/isac322). Security-sensitive reports should follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md). Maintainers may remove content or restrict participation when necessary to keep the project usable and safe.

This code of conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
